title: http(s) before/after strings refuse live_fetch_url with no network
changedFact: job.json before/after are http://127.0.0.1:9/... URL strings as if a live fetch were requested. Engine must refuse live_fetch_url on STDERR (exit 2) without opening a socket and without reading the sibling held JSON files.

source.note: Mechanism case. Loopback port 9 URLs guarantee no public network even if a caller bug attempted a fetch. Local before.json/after.json are unused held snapshots.
